question: Happy birthday, Donadona! You're my favorite character! Thanks for all your hard work, sensei! Something that Echidna likes, and the reason that she came to be called a witch, and if there's an episode from her lifetime, please tell me about it! I'm greedily asking a lot! Even just one thing is fine, so I'm looking forward to a reply!
answer: Aren't you greedy! She likes meat pies, and she was called a witch from when she was born, and an episode from her lifetime was when she showed right up in front of a person in her nightgown, and was teased about it for the longest time!
